figurative_meaning_en: To fall into a trap due to greed
example_sentences_in_bangla: লোভের কারণে সে জাঁতিকলে পড়ে গেল এবং তার সব সম্পদ হারাল।
ব্যবসায়ীটি লোভে জাঁতিকলে পড়ে প্রতারিত হল।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his greed, he fell into the trap and lost everything.
The businessman fell into the trap out of greed and got cheated.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali rural life where oil mills (জাঁতা) were common; animals or pests would fall into them attracted by the oil, symbolizing greed leading to downfall.
note: Synonymous with 'কলে পড়া', emphasizing entrapment through avarice.
